en.title: Lyes Djemaa — Software Development & Distributed Systems
en.description: Final-year Computer Science master’s student at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord. Distributed systems, backend and blockchain projects. Internship from mid-February 2027.
en.intro: I’m a final-year Computer Science master’s student at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord. My projects explore blockchains, process coordination and parallel computing.
en.qDescription: I built a Proof-of-Work blockchain in Python to understand how nodes maintain a shared state. The project brings together signed transactions, a mempool, persistent storage and network synchronization.
en.qDetail: Fork selection is based on cumulative work. A REST API, a CLI and a three-node Docker testnet provide ways to interact with and test the network.
